Requested by the user before handback. You make NO changes: no edits, commits, pushes, or PR comments. Deliverable: findings via `bd update <this-bead> --append-notes`, then `bd close`.

Read first: docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md (R0, R4, A3, **A4**, invariants 1, 3, 5, 12); ADR 0020 §§2–3; AGENTS.md "Permanent Test Evidence" (dispositions retained/demoted/retired; tests are evidence not authority; no weakening); every PR #596 comment (`gh api repos/jbongaarts/eshyra/issues/596/comments -q '.[].body'`) to learn the defect classes found so far; and your own prior review in bead eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.6.

Check, adversarially and completely:
1. **A4 retirement is complete and honest.** No remaining code path, type, packet field, envelope field, report field, or test references the adjudication-context channel; nothing now claims or implies support for rules that lost their entry; the retirement names its replacement responsibilities (AGENTS.md disposition rules) and hides no source-fidelity, discovery, capability, adjudication, or state-integrity defect.
2. **Tool descriptions.** For each of the six changed descriptions (resolve_check, resolve_contest, add_condition, remove_condition, adjust_hp, update_combatant) verify every sentence against the tool's implementation and the state function it calls. Also check whether any OTHER tool-contract fact from the retired entries/PR comments (e.g. reset_usage/needsRolledRestore/restore_usage, spend_spell_slot character-only, spend_turn_resource spellRef, remove_item dispositions, stabilize_character dying-only, start_encounter template-only) is now missing from the owning tool's description where the DM needs it.
3. **Known limits (17 keys).** Each against its record's full source text and named tools: source identity, target domain, tool args/contract, conditional results, source-specific quantities, state ownership/lossy substitutes, trap criterion, registered findingId; R0 comments still accurate after the dataset they referenced was deleted.
4. **Audit projection & report** (ruleDispositions.ts, cli.ts): per-channel shape with implementation + knownLimits only, identity projection, no-runtime-statement semantics (never "unsupported"/"safe"), 175-key set, and the capability ledger reading implementation.
5. **Tests.** Deleted tests: was each ONLY about the retired channel? Adapted tests: same claim, not weakened? New tests proportionate (AGENTS.md)? Any design-required permanent evidence (F-09 §5 permanent rows, invariants 1/3/4/9/11/12) now missing?
6. **Design text.** Is A4 consistent with R4/R5/R6/§5/§8 and A3 as left in the doc (stale references to the retired channel that now mislead)?

Output: for each area, OK or FINDING lines; each FINDING with evidence (file:symbol or doc section), the violated authority, and the minimal fix. Rank most severe first. Don't invent findings.

Dispatched 2026-09-29T22:41:56-05:00: gpt-6-sol effort=high, read-only, PGID 2149501.
Read-only review of PR #596 at 3bd00a07babc6f0e378f8771941a9b9e8d8690ce against origin/main. Read F-09 R0/R4/A3/A4 and invariants, ADR 0020 sections 2-3, prior bead .4.6, PR #596 comments, full diff, affected tool and state paths, audit projection, tests, and all 17 known-limit keys against committed source passages. No files changed; no npm install or test execution was needed. Findings ranked by consequence.

F1 [blocking, incorrect model-facing tool guidance and missing source-backed evidence]: toolResolveContest.ts:resolveContestTool and toolResolveCheck.ts:resolveCheckTool tell the DM to pass a retained hider Stealth total as resolve_check vs for a later active search. The source rule:hiding says the later Perception check contests the retained Stealth total; rule:contests says a tie leaves the situation as it was. resolution.ts:resolveD20 returns success when a check total equals vs, so a tied search is reported as success and can wrongly discover the hider. Also resolve_check schema and validateVs reject retained totals outside 1..99, although a Stealth check can be zero or negative. This violates ADR 0020 section 2 interpretation/state integrity and F-09 A4 tool-contract ownership plus invariant 12. Minimal fix: correct both descriptions to distinguish strict contest comparison from a DC check; roll the search with resolve_check without vs and compare its returned total strictly greater than retained Stealth, leaving a tie hidden, or add a reviewed fixed-contest operation. Add source-backed evidence for the tie and out-of-range totals; the new tools.test.ts assertion merely repeats the current faulty sentence.

F2 [documentation, misleading active contract]: docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md section 1 still states that current F-09 provides per-rule adjudication context; R5 still declares adjudicationContext?: RuleAdjudicationContext in the facade interface; R6 still promises all three channels and packet adjudication context; sections 6 and 8 still call for three channels. A4 explicitly retires that channel and the executable facade has only capabilities and knownLimits. This violates the A4 supersession statement and AGENTS.md disposition clarity. Minimal fix: update those active-looking contract and next-state passages to two channels, preserving historical R4/A3 text as superseded history if desired.

Area 1 A4 retirement: OK in executable code. No remaining adjudication-context symbol, packet field, envelope field, audit field, or runtime test reference found outside historical design text. A4 names replacement responsibilities and empty channels make no support claim.
Area 2 tool descriptions: F1 above. Six changed descriptions otherwise match tool schemas and state operations; reset_usage, restore_usage, spend_turn_resource, remove_item, stabilize_character, and start_encounter already expose the cited contracts in their own descriptions.
Area 3 known limits: OK for all 17 keys: class-features, conflict, experience-points, extra-attack, hit-points-and-hit-dice, multiclassing, multiclassing-proficiency-bonus, special-weapons, spellcasting, channel-divinity, suffocating, action:ready, knocking-a-creature-out, food, water, speed, unarmored-defense, weapon-properties. Correction: this list contains 18 keys, and the actual dataset contains 18 keys; the bead says 17. Registered finding IDs, state ownership, target scope, source clauses, and R0 comments found no additional defect.
Area 4 audit: OK. materializeEngineProcedureCoverage projects implementation and knownLimits by identity; 175 classified procedure keys; no-runtime-statement is a non-claim; the capability ledger reads implementation.
Area 5 tests: deleted checks concern retired context/status fields; adapted projection and source-limit tests retain their claims. F1 needs meaningful permanent regression evidence under F-09 invariant 12; no other missing required permanent evidence found.
Area 6 design: F2 above.
